A community tourism initiative

Local places. Local people. Responsible journeys.

She Guide Project
An initiative of Lifelight Empowerment and Education Council, Kothamangalam – 686691.

This portal is designed to help visitors discover the region and connect with local stays, guides, transport providers and experiences. The long-term aim is to make local tourism information easier to find while supporting community participation and responsible travel.

Website: kothamangalamdevelopmentcouncil.in

Before you travel

Frequently asked questions

Helpful reminders for planning a safe, responsible visit.

Can I book a jeep or tour guide through this website?

You can send an enquiry through WhatsApp. The service provider, availability, price, vehicle suitability and any required permits must be confirmed before the booking is final.

Are forest routes and dams always open to visitors?

No. Some areas are restricted, seasonal or subject to forest, dam, weather and local authority rules. Confirm current access with the relevant authority before travelling.

Is the WhatsApp enquiry a confirmed reservation?

No. It opens a message to the tourism contact. Your reservation is confirmed only after the responsible provider confirms availability, price and terms.

What should I know about rivers and wildlife?

River levels can rise rapidly, especially during rain. Avoid unsafe water, follow local warnings, keep a safe distance from wildlife and never feed or approach elephants.

Can I enquire about a homestay?

Yes. Choose Homestay Booking in the enquiry form and mention your dates, group size, preferred area and facilities. Availability and prices must be confirmed by the host.

Can local hotels, guides and operators be listed?

Yes. Listings should be added after verifying contact details, service area, credentials where applicable, permission to publish and current availability.
